content.title: Standardize webapp ports and add E2E environment safety guard
content.description:
Two related webapp infrastructure changes:

1. PORT CONFIGURATION — standardize the ports the webapp (frontend) and its API server run on:
   - Development: webapp (vite) = 3000, API (hono server) = 3001
   - Validation/E2E: webapp (vite) = 5000, API (hono server) = 5001

2. E2E ISOLATION GUARD — prevent E2E tests from ever creating issues/users against the real development .agentrack/ folder:
   - Add a GET /api/status endpoint to the webapp server that returns { agentrackPath: <resolved AGENTRACK_CWD> }.
   - Add a safety check to the E2E global setup that calls /api/status and aborts the test run if the resolved path is the project's real .agentrack/ directory.

These two deliverables are grouped here because they are co-dependent: the E2E guard must target the final validation API port (5001), so the port change lands first.

Note: this implements the 'root-cause guard' option from the related isolation-hardening idea mqh0su9kgq (the bulk-cleanup portion of that issue is tracked separately).
